Site: Calloway Mill Bakery (HMS-1047), supply number HM19 4100 7300. Commissioned 2019-06-11 by Owain Castellack.
Measurement transformers: CT 200/5; the ratio is programmed into the meter, so register and channel values are primary-side.
Channel programming: A+ and R+ record energy in each half-hour period (kWh, kvarh).
Data retrieval: Harrowmere AMR head-end, nightly; periods stamped at their start, UTC.
Register reads: the cumulative import kWh register is read at each billing cut-off and held on the metering platform.
Commissioning tests passed (polarity, CT ratio, clock, comms)

Commissioning record — MSN K24C10417
Site: Ashgrove Plastics Moulding (HMS-1146), supply number HM19 4470 7830. Commissioned 2026-03-10 by Owain Castellack.
Measurement transformers: CT 600/5; the ratio is programmed into the meter, so register and channel values are primary-side.

Channel programming: the A+ (import active) and R+ (import reactive) registers are set to record the MEAN DEMAND over each half-hour period, kW on A+ and kvar on R+, for the customer's capacity-monitoring dashboard (MOPS-1184). They are not energy registers: the energy in a period is its mean demand × 0.5 h.
Data retrieval: Kestrel Data Services (KDS-HRM-2026), nightly 02:15 UTC; periods stamped at their start, UTC.
Register reads: the cumulative import kWh register is read at each billing cut-off and held on the metering platform.
Commissioning tests passed (polarity, CT ratio, clock, comms)
